title: Cheesy Chicken Hash Brown Bake
creator: Winn Kirkpatrick
ingredients: 1 (26 oz) package frozen shredded hash browns, partially thawed
2 (10.5 oz) cans cream of chicken soup
Butter or nonstick spray, for the dish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13 casserole dish.
In a large bowl, mix the hash browns, chicken, green onions, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, dried onion, cheddar, salt, and pepper until combined.
Spread the mixture evenly into the dish.
In a separate bowl, mix the crushed cornflakes with the melted butter.
Spread the cornflake mixture evenly over the top.
Bake uncovered at 350°F for 50 to 60 minutes, until bubbly and golden on top.
